name: Business Partnership Proposal
subject: Partnership Proposal for {{businessName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I hope this email finds you well.

I was looking at {{businessName}} in {{City}} and was highly impressed by your work. We are currently looking to partner with businesses in your industry to help drive new client growth.

Would you be open to a brief 5-minute call next week to explore how we might collaborate?

Best regards,
[Your Name]
